title: console: the ?palette=1 deep-link is dropped when an app root redirects to its default page
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a product defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin.
2. Open `http://localhost:PORT/_console/apps/showcase_app?palette=1` and wait about 6 s.
3. Expected: the command palette opens, as it does for `?palette=1` on a non-redirecting route such as `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task?palette=1`.
4. Actual: the URL settles on `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/page/showcase_capability_map` with no query string, and no `overlay:command-palette` is open. Reproduced twice.

## Mechanism
The app-root redirect to the app's default page rebuilds the URL without carrying the search params, so the `useUrlOverlay` / `COMMAND_PALETTE_PARAM` (`?palette=1`) state is lost before the overlay reads it. The same likely applies to any URL-overlay param on an app-root link.
